body.name: Subset-inversion observational-null construction
body.construction: For \(h\in\mathcal G^{\mathrm{WARP}}_3\setminus\mathcal E_3\), select \(t\) with \(\sigma_t(h)\ne0\), set \(V=U\setminus t\), \(v_h(S)=\mathbf 1\{h(t\cup S)=t\}\), \(\beta_{t\cup B_0}=\sum_{Q\subseteq B_0}(-1)^{|B_0|-|Q|}v_h(V\setminus Q)\), \(n_h=1\), and \(n_{g_{C_0}}=-\beta_{C_0}\) for \(C_0\supseteq t\), with all remaining \(n_g=0\). Under both \(P_+\) and \(P_-\), assign mass \(q_g=1/9\) to each of the eight maps \(g_{C_0}\) and to \(h\); choose \(\varepsilon=(36\max_g|n_g|)^{-1}\); set \(P_\pm(Y(s)=1\mid G=g)=1/2\) for \(s\ne t\) and \(P_\pm(Y(t)=1\mid G=g)=1/2\pm\varepsilon n_g/q_g\), with the potential outcomes conditionally mutually independent.
